card.name: The letter m starting a new word
card.fires_on: The separate piece "m" that begins or continues a word, as in mums, mEq, mCi, moods, menses and mounds. It often follows a space or a number and is split from the rest of the word.

modes.label: m in units
modes.description: The letter m split off at the start of a unit such as mEq or mCi after a number or slash.
modes.example: (10<< m>>Eq each of sodium and bicarbonate)

modes.label: m opening a plain word
modes.description: The letter m split off at the start of an ordinary word such as mounds, menses, mazes, moods or mated, with the rest of the word following.
modes.example: Water<< m>>ounds with a fine mist.

card.plain: It fires when a word or unit is split so that just the letter m shows first, before the rest of the word appears.
